questions.stem: What is the square root of 9?
questions.solution: The square root of 9 is 3 because 3 × 3 equals 9. The other options are incorrect because 9 × 9 is 81, 2 × 2 is 4, and 6 × 6 is 36.

hi.solution: 9 का वर्गमूल 3 है क्योंकि 3 × 3 बराबर 9 है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि 9 × 9 81 है, 2 × 2 4 है और 6 × 6 36 है।

questions.stem: What is the square root of 144 using the factors method?

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct representation of 3^2 × 3^5?
questions.solution: When multiplying expressions with the same base, the exponents are added. Therefore, 3^2 × 3^5 equals 3^(2+5) = 3^7. The option 9^5 is incorrect because it changes the base and does not apply the exponent addition rule. 3^10 and 9^10 are also incorrect because they do not follow the correct application of exponent rules.

questions.stem: If the square of a number is between 11.7 and 11.8, what is the possible value of the square root?
questions.solution: If the square of a number is between 11.7 and 11.8, the square root must be between 3.4 and 3.5 because 3.4² = 11.56 and 3.5² = 12.25. The only option that lies in this range is 3.5. The other options are incorrect because they are either too low or too high.

hi.solution: यदि किसी संख्या का वर्ग 11.7 और 11.8 के बीच है, तो वर्गमूल 3.4 और 3.5 के बीच होना चाहिए क्योंकि 3.4² = 11.56 और 3.5² = 12.25 है। इस रेंज में केवल 3.5 ही है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे या तो बहुत कम हैं या बहुत अधिक हैं।
